answer.summary: The API test shard fails at Spring context startup, not in test logic. Bean creation hits a circular dependency: workflowService to workflowEndService to notificationEventService to scenarioNotificationEventHandler to exerciseService back to workflowService. The change touches WorkflowEndService and NotificationEventService, so it likely introduced the cycle. This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run, so retrying won't help. The 419 errors are all context-load failures from this cause.

evidence.quote: Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default.
